# Source of Truth

Personal AI Engineering playbook by Defftripp.

Core idea:
- requirements and product context live in files;
- research is reference, not automatic requirement;
- work moves through stages and checkpoints;
- agent output is verified by reviewer/test-auditor/security scopes;
- every meaningful change leaves evidence.

Main sections:
- /blog/
- /playbook/
- /research/
- /prompts/
